# Athlete profile

Personal baselines used by the copilote. `faimNormal` / `soifNormal` are *your*
normal appetite/thirst on a 1–5 scale — deviation in either direction is a signal,
not "more is better". Threshold HR / FTP are per-athlete, never hard-coded.
